content:
An open letter on what the industry says about keeping humans in the work, and what actually lands in your inbox

In this issue

  • What a model cannot do. A model has read what has already been published.
  • The One Question. I asked people on the show floor a single question.
  • Nobody checked. Corinne's email did not fail because a machine wrote it.
  • Where "them" went. Somebody prompted a model with the context. Write a cold email to this guy Brent, we did this work for this client, here are the numbers.
  • Email got there first. I moderated two fireside chats at eTail East in Boston.
  • Naming the step. This is where I tell you what I do differently, and it only earns the space because I am about to ask you to put the same question to whoever writes for you.
  • Would a, Could a, Should a. The people I asked told me a human has to be in it, and I believe them.
